title: Spoon Ferry Lunchbox Harbor Paper Tab Story Inference Card
inferenceSkill: Use a fictional clue, what it might suggest, why, a second clue, an inference sentence, and a paper tab check: ____________________.
useCase: Adult-led offline paper-only inference card for a pretend Spoon Ferry Lunchbox Harbor story: ____________________.
adultSetup: Adult: place a blank page, pencil, and small paper tabs beside the invented spoon ferry harbor card: ____________________.
kidDirection: Writer: invent a lunchbox harbor, a spoon ferry, and a careful dock helper who notices calm paper clues: ____________________.
cluePrompt: clue: write one pretend spoon ferry detail, lid mark, or dock signal the helper notices first: ____________________.
suggestsPrompt: might suggest: write what the first clue might suggest about what the dock helper should do next: ____________________.
whyPrompt: why: explain why that clue points to your idea inside the invented harbor story: ____________________.
secondCluePrompt: second clue: add one different harbor detail that supports the same inference: ____________________.
inferenceSentencePrompt: inference sentence: write one sentence that uses the clue, what it might suggest, why, and the second clue: ____________________.
paperTabCheckPrompt: paper tab check: mark the paper tab when the inference sentence stays pretend, calm, and paper-only: ____________________.
quietOptionLine: Quiet option: fill the clue and second clue blanks first, then adult-scribe the inference sentence: ____________________.
takeHomeLine: Take-home line: keep this spoon ferry card for one later adult-led paper tab check: ____________________.
